sentences.en: A fourth-year pupil at Amery Hill School, Alton, she also enjoys writing.

sentences.en: Fourth-year juniors can produce project booklets for first or second-year juniors.

sentences.en: Fourth-year engineering student Steve, 21, is alleged to have been booted as he lay helpless on the ground.

sentences.en: Fourth-year students carry out an original research project under staff supervision.

sentences.en: The fourth-year combo guard continued his development into a star last year and will be counted on to help replace Davis as Golden State's main playmaker .

sentences.en: Bright and articulate, the fourth-year medical student at Cairo University was involved in the pro-democracy protests that brought down the 30 year rule of Hosni Mubarak.

sentences.en: A group of 16 fourth-year students in the college of electric and information engineering are randomly chosen as the subjects of the study.

sentences.en: Two intact classes were selected from the fourth-year students majored in Primary School English Teaching at Wendeng Normal School.

sentences.en: Head, a fourth-year point guard, can be a free agent after this season.
